summary: Cedar Bench School District wants the kitchen exhaust hoods, exhaust fans and gas-fired make-up air units replaced in the kitchens of three schools, including connection to the existing fire suppression systems by a licensed fire suppression subcontractor. The engineer's estimate is $180,000 and the work must be done between June 7 and July 23, 2027. Sealed bids are due at the District Purchasing Office by 2:00 p.m. on Tuesday, March 30, 2027.

notes.text: All the work at three schools must be done inside a fixed window, June 7 to July 23, 2027. The text gives no dates for award or for when work may start being planned on site.

The connection to the existing fire suppression systems must be made by a licensed fire suppression subcontractor, and you must name that subcontractor on the Bid Form. The text does not say which licence the subcontractor must hold; the only licence it names is the bidder's S350.

The text says the winner must furnish the bonds 'and a certificate of insurance within ten days of the notice of award'. I read the ten days as applying to the bonds as well as the certificate, but the wording could mean the certificate only.

All workers on school property must pass a background check under District Policy 3120. As written that would include the subcontractor's workers. The text does not say when the checks must be done or who pays for them.
The text does not say what form the bid security must take (bond, check or other), and does not state the insurance types or amounts required. The walk-through on March 16 is not required.
